description: This file defines the main engine configuration data structure and related functions for engine setup, including configuration parameters, setter functions, and external references used in the engine control software.

methods.name: getRpmMultiplier
methods.description: Returns the RPM multiplier based on the operation mode.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the current operation mode of the engine in the configuration.

methods.name: prepareVoidConfiguration
methods.description: Prepares an empty or default engine configuration.

methods.name: setDefaultConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the engine configuration to default settings.

methods.name: setTargetRpmCurve
methods.description: Sets the RPM target curve for engine operation.

methods.name: setAfrMap
methods.description: Sets the AFR (Air-Fuel Ratio) map with specified values.

methods.name: setMap
methods.description: Sets a specified fuel table with the given value.

methods.name: setWholeFuelMap
methods.description: Sets the entire fuel map to a specific value.

methods.name: setWholeIgnitionIatCorr
methods.description: Sets the entire ignition correction table based on IAT.

methods.name: setFuelTablesLoadBin
methods.description: Configures load bins for fuel table loading.

methods.name: setWholeIatCorrTimingTable
methods.description: Sets the entire IAT correction timing table.

methods.name: setWholeTimingTable_d
methods.description: Sets the entire timing table with a specified angle value.

methods.name: setConstantDwell
methods.description: Sets constant dwell time for ignition.

methods.name: printFloatArray
methods.description: Prints an array of float values with a prefix.

methods.name: setDefaultBasePins
methods.description: Sets default pin configuration.

methods.name: setDefaultSerialParameters
methods.description: Sets default serial communication parameters.

methods.name: setDefaultSdCardParameters
methods.description: Sets default SD card parameters.

methods.name: rememberCurrentConfiguration
methods.description: Remembers the current engine configuration.

methods.name: incrementGlobalConfigurationVersion
methods.description: Increments the global configuration version.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigurationVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current global configuration version.

methods.name: commonFrankensoAnalogInputs
methods.description: Handles analog inputs for a specific engine configuration.

methods.name: setFrankenso0_1_joystick
methods.description: Sets joystick parameters in the engine configuration.

methods.name: copyTargetAfrTable
methods.description: Copies source AFR table to destination.

methods.name: copyFuelTable
methods.description: Copies source fuel table to destination.

methods.name: copyTimingTable
methods.description: Copies source timing table to destination.
